input.content: Pattern: "simplifying" an ownership-guarded delete into an unconditional delete of shared keyed state. Example: cleanup_setup(store, workspace_id, setup_id) dropped the check `active[workspace_id]["setup_id"] == setup_id` and called store.active.pop(workspace_id) unconditionally. When a failed job's queued cleanup runs after a newer setup completed for the same workspace, it deletes the newer, valid association (active_connection -> None). Review rule: a cleanup or compensation path keyed by a shared key (workspace, tenant, resource) must verify it owns the record before deleting it. The existing own-record test still passes, so require a test for the "other owner" case. Severity P1.
